v11.81 - b-13 sonrasi: scratchpad depoya girmesin

Two one-shot helpers landed in the previous commit because `scratchpad/` was an
empty folder git had never seen and therefore did not ignore. The repo already
has a scratch convention and it is `.tmp/` — ignored, except for the reusable
tools (`.tmp/bridge.js` already posts bridge payloads, which is what one of the
two was reinventing). `scratchpad/` now follows the same rule, stated by KIND
beside it rather than as a second list of names.
